candidates.mechanism: Default KNNImputer on unscaled Age/VIP/cabin/CryoSleep/spending values, then OHE HomePlanet/Destination, spending aggregates and fixed composite sums; default LightGBM selected among five classifiers.
candidates.new_vs_our_work: KNN attribute imputation is more specific than rule/surname imputation, but this source provides no controlled evidence that it improves prediction. The tree family and most engineered features are already covered.
candidates.reproducibility_status: Short notebook contains a complete model-based prediction path and no fixed prediction payload was observed. Dependencies/defaults and random forest/tree seeds are not fully pinned; historical leaderboard claim is not independently verified.
limitations: KNN preprocessing is fit on concatenated train and test features before validation splitting. Target is not an imputer input, so this is transductive attribute preprocessing, not direct label propagation; it nevertheless differs from our strict train-only preprocessing protocol.
Unscaled amenity spending and cabin numbers dominate Euclidean-style imputation distances; no imputation ablation is shown.
A correlation exploration includes the dummy-false test target, so its feature-ranking interpretation is unreliable. The target itself is dropped before classifier fitting.
One non-stratified20%validation split, default model comparison, and no final full-train refit do not establish a robust method-level advantage.
Do not reproduce blanket numeric treatment of imputed binary fields or synthetic composite sums merely because the README claims Top7%.
